prompt: /stepwise-git:commit (rate_limiter.py, context: security incident with brute-force attacks)

assertions.text: Commit message mentions the reason for the change (security, brute-force protection, or incident mitigation) — not just 'add rate limiter'
Subject line is NOT a pure restatement of the diff like 'Add rate_limiter.py' or 'Modify auth module'
Uses the session conversation context to inform the commit message — does not ask the user what was changed
